## Overview

Part of the [**Data Science Projects Collection**](https://github.com/PaulChanCyber/Data-Science-Project-) (Book analysis)—Exploratory analysis of book sales and publishing trends from scraped market data.

## Problem & Data

Understanding how title, genre, pricing, and demand signals relate in the book retail market.

## Approach

Data collection and cleaning, summary statistics, trend visualization, and comparative analysis across categories.

## Technologies

Python · pandas · Matplotlib · Seaborn · Jupyter

## Outcomes

Actionable insights into sales patterns and category performance for retail and publishing analytics.
